description: This PHP script handles various device reset and reboot actions, including factory reset, WiFi reset, MAC filter table management, and user password reset, based on POST input. It also includes session validation and external utility functions.

methods.name: delMacFilterTable
methods.description: Deletes MAC filter entries for specified access points and disables MAC filtering.

methods.name: delMacFilterTables
methods.description: Deletes MAC filter entries for a predefined set of access points.
